title: Status
description: What a Node reports about itself on g2labs/<node-id>/status.

node_id.description: The Node ID: the Wi-Fi MAC as 12 lowercase hex digits.

name.description: The friendly name. Left out when none is set.

network.description: SSID of the current Known Network.

rssi.description: RSSI of the Wi-Fi link in dBm; null when the Wi-Fi driver can't report it.

free_heap.description: Free heap memory in bytes, summed over all heaps.
